rows.text: The Cabinet Secretariat memorandum dated 30 May 2019 states that Shri Narendra Modi has been sworn in as the Prime Minister by the President at 1900 hours that day in Rashtrapati Bhavan, and that the listed ministers were sworn in at the same time.
